leads.title: Consultation requests
leads.sub: Opening a lead deducts the view fee from your lead credit. The grade sets the amount.
leads.emptyAll: No consultation requests yet. Leads are assigned only when you have an approved service in a consultation category, service areas and a lead credit balance (insurance, cards, finance, telecom and medical require passing the qualification review first).
leads.expiredNote: The viewing period expired and the lead went to another business.
leads.reviewingTitle: SogaeBank is reviewing your rejection request. It will open once a decision is made.
leads.legacyLead: This is a legacy lead with no separately stored contact.
leads.expiredTitle: Expired and can no longer be opened.
leads.gradeNote: Partners do not enter a view fee for each grade. Set just one top view fee and every grade is filled in by multiplying it by the 8 grade rates. Which grade applies is decided by the KakaoTalk notification result.
leads.gradeTop: Based on a top view fee of {fee} (the highest S rate among your categories — Rates · referral fees).
leads.alimWarn: KakaoTalk / SMS integration is not live yet. Leads coming in now are therefore Ungraded and charged at the base rate — once integrated, grades will follow the delivery result (our team may also enter verified results).
leads.capFail: Could not load the rejection limit.
leads.capNote: Rejections must be within 72 hours of receipt, once per lead, and up to 15% of monthly leads. Without a limit, leads could be used up without paying view fees. A consultation falling through is not a reason for rejection.

memo.ph: e.g. Morning call · quote re-requested (do not enter contact details)

view.confirm: Opening deducts the view fee{fee} from your lead credit — bonus balance is used first. Name, mobile and email will be shown and the view is logged.

rejects.title: Rejections · disputes
rejects.sub: Request a rejection for leads that came in by mistake. If accepted, the view fee is refunded.
rejects.empty: You have not requested any rejections.
rejects.deducted: removed from billing (postpaid, before the switch)
rejects.eligNote: A rejection is eligible only if all three conditions are met: within 72 hours of receipt, once per lead, and within the 15% monthly limit. Eligibility is checked automatically by the system.
rejects.judgeNote: A consultation falling through is not a reason for rejection. SogaeBank decides based on risk-detection rules — if accepted, the deducted amount returns to your balance as it was (the bonus share as bonus).
rejects.otherNote: For other disputes (amount or grade), please contact the Help Center.

settle.noteSrv: These are settlements paid by SogaeBank. Once confirmed, they are sent to your verified payout account on the next month's payout day (3.3% withheld). Referral fees are paid directly between the parties, so they do not appear here.
settle.title: Settlement
settle.sub: Settlements for completed referrals and your payout account.
settle.needId: Identity verification is required. Settlements are paid after identity verification (business verification is optional — individuals get receipts instead of tax invoices).
settle.empty: No settlements yet. Confirmed settlements appear here and are paid on day {day} of the following month.
settle.stub: 1-won verification not yet integrated — treated as verified
settle.accNote: If you change the account, it must be verified again before payout.
settle.invEmpty: No invoices issued. Monthly tax invoices for settlement payouts and lead credit (paid balance used) will appear here.
settle.etaxNote: NTS e-tax invoice integration is not live yet. “Issue requested” means the amount is confirmed, and “Awaiting transmission — not integrated” means SogaeBank has issued it but it has not yet been sent to the NTS. The approval number appears once sent.
settle.unpaidNote: Unbilled postpaid fees from before the switch, {amt} ({n, plural, one {{n} item} other {{n} items}}), will be billed as before (Partner Terms, Article 6).

cash.title: Lead credit
cash.notPartner: You are not a partner. Please start with an application.
cash.sub: The balance used when you open leads. With a zero balance you cannot receive consultations.
cash.payFail: The payment was not completed. Please top up again — no money was taken.
cash.orderNote: Deductions come from the bonus first, then the paid balance. If a rejection is accepted, the amount paid is refunded to your balance as is. Used this month: {used} (bonus {bonus}).
cash.zeroNote: No new consultations are assigned while your balance is empty. Top up and you will receive them again right away.
cash.autoNote: Auto top-up charges the same card (billing key) as your subscription. When the balance drops below the set amount it tops up once immediately, and retries an hour later if it fails. Payment is confirmed by the payment provider's approval.
cash.logEmpty: No history yet. It will appear here once you top up.
cash.legacyNote: Unbilled postpaid fees from before the switch, {amt} ({n, plural, one {{n} item} other {{n} items}}), will be billed as before — see Settlement.
cash.useNote: Credit can only be used to prepay SogaeBank lead view fees. It cannot be used at other merchants, given to other members or exchanged for cash; the paid balance is refunded by payment cancellation (grade discounts are not refundable). You can top up up to {max} at a time and hold up to {maxBal} of paid balance.

pay.title: Top-up confirmation
pay.noInfo: No payment information. Please top up again from Lead credit.

cashPanel.noPerm: Only the owner account or staff with settlement permission can top up.
cashPanel.chargeInfo: Grade discount {pct}% — a bonus of {bonus} is added · {min} ~ {max} per top-up · You can add up to {room} now
cashPanel.stubInfo: Test payment (no payment key is set, so no real money moves)
cashPanel.noCard: No registered card (billing key), so auto top-up will not run
cashPanel.cardNote: Register a card in Subscription · payment — auto top-up uses the same card.
cashPanel.refundConfirm: {amt} of paid balance will be returned by payment cancellation. The grade discount (bonus) from that top-up will be clawed back. Continue?

services.title: My services
services.sub: Your registered services and their visibility. Editing triggers a new review.
services.noApproved: No approved services, so no leads will arrive. Services under review are not shown.
services.empty: No services registered. Start with “✚ Add service”.
services.inReview: Awaiting SogaeBank review — no leads until approved
services.mxOf: Quote cells of “{title}” — edit them on the service details page.
services.mxEmpty: No matrix-quote service. Categories that quote by “move type × volume”, like moving, fill the cells at registration.
services.axisNote: Quote axes (move type, volume) are set in the category master. SogaeBank adds or changes axes in the category master — changes apply without an app update.
services.rejNote: If rejected, fix and resubmit instead of registering again. A new submission puts the same item in the review queue twice. Listings with banned phrases (‘principal guaranteed’, ‘100% success’, etc.) are not accepted.

svcDetail.title: Service details · detail page
svcDetail.sub: The detail page is built by stacking blocks.
svcDetail.recvLine: {n} ({v, plural, one {{v} contact} other {{v} contacts}} opened)
svcDetail.rejFix: Do not register again — fix it via “Edit service” and resubmit.
svcDetail.blockNote: The detail page is built by stacking blocks. Block order and visibility change without deployment.
svcDetail.editNote: Editing a live service sends it back to review — no leads arrive in the meantime. Changing only the view fee or referral fee keeps it live.

svcNew.noteSrv: The category determines the registration form. Regulated categories have a fixed intake method (Insurance Business Act · Medical Service Act Article 27), and categories without a registration method cannot be registered yet.
svcNew.title: Add service
svcNew.sub: The category you choose sets the registration form. Regulated categories have a fixed intake method.
svcNew.noteFb: The category determines the registration form.
svcNew.undecidedNote: No form type assigned, so registration and rate entry are blocked
svcNew.bannedNote: Listings with banned phrases are not accepted. Phrases promising guaranteed results, such as ‘principal guaranteed’ or ‘100% success’, are caught automatically and the rejection reason shows the exact phrase.
svcNew.simpleSummary: Simple listing (service name and description only, no category)

form.name: Service name
form.descPh: Describe what you do and what requests you would like to receive.

listings.title: My listings
listings.sub: Register and manage your Safe Referral listings here. Each business line needs onboarding approval before listings are published.
listings.needId: Identity verification comes first. Once verified, you can choose the business lines to join here (business verification is optional).
listings.empty: No listings registered. Start with “Register listing” below.
listings.formNote: Registration opens the same referral form as the user site. Categories in business lines that are not approved yet cannot be selected.
listings.gateNote: Listings are not published before onboarding approval. Only businesses approved for that business line can publish Safe Referral listings — posts made before approval are blocked (MAL_PARTNER_ONLY).
listings.dirNote: Law and tax office listings (monthly flat fee) can be requested after your onboarding application is approved.

tools.editConfirm: Your edits require a new review — the service goes back to In review until approved and receives no leads meanwhile. Save?
tools.suspendConfirm: Hiding the service blocks only new leads; ongoing consultations continue. Hide the service?
tools.name: Service name
tools.targetPh1: e.g. Seoul household moves · office relocation
tools.editHint: Changing only the view fee or referral fee keeps the service live; changing the name, description, target or intake method triggers a new review.
tools.cellsSaved: Saved {n, plural, one {{n} cell} other {{n} cells}}.
tools.noAxis: Quote ranges (axes) are not defined for this category yet — SogaeBank manages the category master.
tools.mxUnit: Unit: 10,000 KRW · empty cells show as “Ask for a quote”
tools.namePhMx: e.g. Hanbit packing moves · all of Seoul
tools.descPh: What you do and what requests you would like to receive
tools.fixedReceive: Regulated categories have a fixed intake method (Insurance Business Act · Medical Service Act Art. 27).
tools.targetPh2: e.g. Household moves in Seoul and southern Gyeonggi, three rooms or more
tools.mxHint: Enter base quotes (10,000 KRW) in the move type × volume cells — SogaeBank defines the axes in the category master.
tools.noAxisShort: Quote ranges are not defined for this category yet.
tools.topHint: Set just the top view fee and all 8 grades are filled in automatically.
tools.refPctLblWiz: Referral fee on deal (% of deal value) — negotiable range 5 ~ 12
tools.rebateLblWiz: Re-referral bonus (KRW per case · re-contract within 3 months)
tools.refDirect: Referral fees are paid directly between the parties — not through SogaeBank (Terms of Use, Article 3).
tools.blockPhWiz: Leave blank to show “Empty” — do not enter phone numbers
tools.nextVal: SogaeBank review — no leads until approved
tools.pickH: 1. Choose a category — the category sets the registration form
